description: This file is the code-behind for the 'ExamResult' page in the Online Exam System. It handles the display and calculation of exam results, updating user information in the database, and navigation button events.

classes.name: ExamResult
classes.description: Partial class inheriting from System.Web.UI.Page, responsible for handling page load events and button click events related to displaying exam results and user navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, retrieves session data, updates user exam statistics in the database, and displays exam questions, answers, and tags.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the User Profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout and navigation to the Login page.
